complications.name: Camera sweep
complications.text: A camera swivels and finds the crew standing very still in the open.
complications.absorbed_text: The camera swivels, finds nothing interesting and swivels back.
complications.flavor: It is a very slow camera. It is also a very judgemental one.

complications.name: The watchman stirs
complications.text: The night watchman stirs in his chair. Somebody was too loud.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman half-opens one eye, hears nothing, and half-closes it.
complications.flavor: He mutters something about wanting to be a pastry chef.

complications.name: The watchman walks his rounds
complications.text: The now-awake watchman ambles down the corridor, flashlight swinging.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman ambles right past, humming.
complications.flavor: He is humming a song about a lighthouse.

complications.name: School trip
complications.text: A school trip floods the gallery. Forty children, one very tired teacher.
complications.absorbed_text: The school trip is gently steered toward the gift shop.
complications.flavor: One child asks what the crew's names are. Three of the crew lie.

complications.name: A cat strolls in
complications.text: A cat strolls in as if it owns the place. It is not on the guest list.
complications.absorbed_text: The cat is offered a better spot and strolls off with great dignity.
complications.flavor: The cat has no comment.

complications.name: The vase falls
complications.text: The cat knocks a priceless-looking vase off its shelf. It lands loudly.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick hand catches the vase. The cat looks disappointed.
complications.flavor: The vase was a replica of a replica.

complications.name: Freshly mopped
complications.text: The cleaner has mopped the whole gallery and left no sign at all.
complications.absorbed_text: A very small, very quick woman mops up the mop-up.
complications.flavor: The sign is in the cleaner's pocket.

complications.name: The dust sheets come off
complications.text: Someone whips the dust sheets off the display. A great grey cloud rolls out.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick fan of a hat keeps the dust where it is.
complications.flavor: The dust has been waiting a long time for this.

complications.name: The alarm goes off
complications.text: The watchman sees the crew, shrieks, and pulls the alarm lever with great enthusiasm.
complications.absorbed_text: The watchman reaches for the lever and is handed a cup of tea instead.
complications.flavor: The alarm plays a jaunty tune. It is the same tune as the doorbell.

complications.name: The curator does a tour
complications.text: The curator wanders through, peering at every visitor and asking who invited them.
complications.absorbed_text: The curator is introduced to an enthusiastic 'new volunteer' and wanders off, flattered.
complications.flavor: She has a clipboard. She is not afraid to use it.

complications.name: Inspector Bramble drops by
complications.text: Inspector Bramble pops in to ask why a mug from the staff kitchen is in somebody's pocket.
complications.absorbed_text: Inspector Bramble is talked into a long tour of the building and forgets the question.
complications.flavor: Bramble has been inspecting this museum for eleven years and has never found anything.

complications.name: The pit boss does a lap
complications.text: The pit boss does a slow lap of the floor, squinting at every stranger in a bad jacket.
complications.absorbed_text: The pit boss is handed a drink by a very friendly stranger and forgets what he was squinting at.
complications.flavor: His moustache has its own security clearance.

complications.name: A high roller says hello
complications.text: A high roller swears he has met one of the crew before, at a wedding, in another country.
complications.absorbed_text: The high roller is steered to the buffet by someone with a lovely smile.
complications.flavor: He has not met anyone before. He says this a lot.

complications.name: The band strikes up
complications.text: The house band strikes up a very enthusiastic polka. Every pot and pan in the building hums along.
complications.absorbed_text: The polka starts, and nobody in the crew even flinches.
complications.flavor: The accordion player has a lot of opinions.

complications.name: A bouncer turns his head
complications.text: A very large bouncer hears the commotion and turns his very large head.
complications.absorbed_text: The bouncer glances over, sees only a band and a buffet, and turns back.
complications.flavor: He has a name tag that just says 'Sir'.

complications.name: A swell rocks the barge
complications.text: A passing ferry sends a swell under the barge. Every chip on every table slides an inch to the left.
complications.absorbed_text: The barge lurches, and a steady pair of hands keeps everything where it should be.
complications.flavor: The ferry's captain waves cheerfully.

complications.name: A seagull sees the haul
complications.text: A seagull dives out of nowhere, snatches a fistful of chips, and leaves with great dignity.
complications.absorbed_text: A sharp eye spots the seagull in time, and the haul stays in the bag.
complications.flavor: The seagull cashes in at a rival barge later that week.

complications.name: The cash cart blocks the way
complications.text: A trolley of cash chips wedges itself across the corridor, with a wobbly wheel and a very loud squeak.
complications.absorbed_text: The trolley is parked neatly out of the way, with no squeak.
complications.flavor: Its wheel has opinions about the polka.

complications.name: The auditor counts everything
complications.text: The casino auditor notices a small souvenir missing and begins, patiently, to count everything on the barge.
complications.absorbed_text: The auditor is taken to see a very fine view and loses count.
complications.flavor: He counts in his sleep.

complications.name: The fumes hit
complications.text: The aged-cheese fumes roll in like a wall of warm socks. Someone has to sit down.
complications.absorbed_text: A sharp eye sees the whiff coming and the whole crew breathes through their sleeves.
complications.flavor: The smell is described, by a crew member, as 'moist'.

complications.name: A parade of mice
complications.text: Forty mice march through in a very tidy line, squeaking, toward the good cheese.
complications.absorbed_text: The mice are gently redirected toward the snack table, squeaking approvingly.
complications.flavor: The lead mouse has a tiny hat.

complications.name: The humidity monitor beeps
complications.text: A humidity monitor starts beeping, because someone opened a door in the wrong order.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick hand resets the monitor before it finishes its second beep.
complications.flavor: The monitor has never beeped before and sounds embarrassed.

complications.name: A wheel rolls loose
complications.text: A cheese wheel the size of a tractor tyre rolls off its shelf and thunders away down the cellar steps.
complications.absorbed_text: Two strong arms catch the wheel, and the room breathes out.
complications.flavor: It rolls all the way to the car park, which is further than it sounds.

complications.name: The night affineur turns the wheels
complications.text: The night affineur shuffles through, turning wheels and tutting at the crew's footprints.
complications.absorbed_text: The affineur is asked about his favourite wheel and talks happily for ten minutes.
complications.flavor: He talks to the cheese. The cheese is a good listener.

complications.name: The trail leads home
complications.text: A very faint, very distinctive smell of cheese leads a keen-nosed inspector straight to the van.
complications.absorbed_text: The inspector is given a sample and loses the trail in joy.
complications.flavor: The inspector's nose is famous.

complications.name: Fog rolls in
complications.text: Fog rolls up the hill and swallows the path, the van and, briefly, someone's sense of direction.
complications.absorbed_text: A sharp-eyed lookout calls out the path and nobody wanders into the fog.
complications.flavor: Even the fog looks a little lost.

complications.name: Someone wanders off
complications.text: In the fog, somebody follows a promising-sounding noise and ends up in a hedge.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick whistle brings everybody back to the path.
complications.flavor: The hedge is very nice about it.

complications.name: The telescope swings
complications.text: A vintage telescope swings loose on its mount and clangs against the dome like a gong.
complications.absorbed_text: Two strong hands catch the telescope before it clangs.
complications.flavor: It was built in a time before anyone asked about safety.

complications.name: A lens catches the light
complications.text: A polished lens catches the sky and throws a dazzling white flash across the room.
complications.absorbed_text: A deft hand tilts the lens away before it flashes.
complications.flavor: It was only trying to be helpful.

complications.name: Everybody is dazzled
complications.text: Everyone blinks away the flash and tries to work while seeing purple spots.
complications.absorbed_text: A seasoned lookout shields their eyes and keeps working.
complications.flavor: The spots are, apparently, very pretty.

complications.name: The night astronomer looks up
complications.text: The night astronomer pulls her eye from the eyepiece and peers suspiciously at the corridor.
complications.absorbed_text: The astronomer is asked about Saturn, and the rest of the night disappears.
complications.flavor: She has named all her telescopes.

complications.name: A star-gazing party
complications.text: A star-gazing club arrives in thermal socks, and they all want to look through everything.
complications.absorbed_text: The club is shown to the roof, delighted, with a free biscuit each.
complications.flavor: One of them is carrying a very large flask.

complications.name: A cold snap
complications.text: A cold snap sweeps in. Fingers turn stiff, and a screwdriver is dropped from a dignified height.
complications.absorbed_text: A flask of something warm goes round and the cold is forgotten.
complications.flavor: Someone's breath looks like a ghost.

complications.name: The radio squawks
complications.text: A forgotten radio on a shelf crackles to life and begins to read the shipping forecast.
complications.absorbed_text: The radio squawks and everyone calmly pretends to be a ham operator.
complications.flavor: Gale warnings in the west.

complications.name: A shooting star
complications.text: A shooting star streaks overhead and one crew member stops dead in a window to make a wish.
complications.absorbed_text: A gentle nudge keeps the wishing to a quick one.
complications.flavor: They will not say what they wished for.

complications.name: A cloud of pollen
complications.text: A gust through the vents lifts a golden cloud of pollen off every bloom in the row.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick fan of a hat keeps the pollen where it is.
complications.flavor: It smells like a wedding.

complications.name: The sprinklers come on
complications.text: The sprinklers come on, on a timer nobody wrote down, and everything below waist height is wet.
complications.absorbed_text: A big umbrella of a person shelters the haul from the sprinklers.
complications.flavor: The timer is older than the dome.

complications.name: The gardener does the rounds
complications.text: The head gardener does her rounds, prodding leaves and sniffing at the soil.
complications.absorbed_text: The gardener is asked about her ferns and the rounds go on for ever.
complications.flavor: The ferns have been waiting for this.

complications.name: The parrot repeats everything
complications.text: A large parrot in the palm court repeats everything the crew just whispered, loudly, in their own voices.
complications.absorbed_text: The parrot repeats a bit, then loses interest.
complications.flavor: It also does a very good alarm clock.

complications.name: A butterfly swarm
complications.text: A swarm of butterflies lifts off a flowering bush, and every visitor stops to point.
complications.absorbed_text: The butterflies are steered gently toward the cafe.
complications.flavor: Several are of questionable origin.

complications.name: A vine grabs a sleeve
complications.text: A heavy vine drops from the roof and loops itself through somebody's belt. It will not let go.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick pair of clippers frees the sleeve before the vine gets any ideas.
complications.flavor: Somebody calls it Gerald.

complications.name: The steam vents
complications.text: A steam vent bursts open and the whole corridor is a warm, wet cloud.
complications.absorbed_text: A deft hand shuts the vent before the cloud gathers.
complications.flavor: It smells faintly of soup.

complications.name: A guided tour
complications.text: A guided tour arrives and the guide asks the crew a pointed question about orchids.
complications.absorbed_text: The tour is waved on by a confident-looking person with a clipboard.
complications.flavor: The guide has a flag on a stick.

complications.name: The fountain overflows
complications.text: The fountain in the palm court overflows with a happy gurgle and floods the whole walkway.
complications.absorbed_text: A mop appears from nowhere and the flood is over in a minute.
complications.flavor: It is a very large frog statue.

complications.name: The seed inspector
complications.text: A seed inspector notices a small pocket of rare seeds is missing and begins to ask polite, pointed questions.
complications.absorbed_text: The inspector is given a cup of tea and a lot of paperwork to read.
complications.flavor: Every seed has a name.

complications.name: The pigeons take off
complications.text: A flock of pigeons bursts off the roof in a great flapping cloud. The museum was named for them.
complications.absorbed_text: The pigeons settle again, and nobody even looks up.
complications.flavor: The pigeons have a union.

complications.name: The monthly drill
complications.text: A very loud bell rings. It is the monthly fire drill, and everyone is now in the corridor with a clipboard.
complications.absorbed_text: The drill is waved through by someone with a convincing lanyard.
complications.flavor: It was last month's drill. Nobody told the bell.

complications.name: The gift shop rush
complications.text: A coach party rushes the gift shop. Every shelf of tote bags is attacked at once.
complications.absorbed_text: The coach party is pointed toward a half-price rack on the far side.
complications.flavor: One person buys nine tea towels.

complications.name: A loose floorboard
complications.text: A floorboard declares itself in the middle of the corridor with a creak like an old door.
complications.absorbed_text: A watchful eye spots the board and the crew step around it.
complications.flavor: It creaks in B flat.

complications.name: Someone spills the tea
complications.text: A staff member, startled by nothing, spills an entire pot of tea down the middle of the corridor.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick cloth and the tea is gone before it has the chance to spread.
complications.flavor: The pot was a gift from an aunt.

complications.name: A very small dog
complications.text: A very small dog of unclear ownership trots in, sniffing every ankle.
complications.absorbed_text: The dog is given a biscuit and a sofa to sit on.
complications.flavor: It has a better name than any of the crew.

complications.name: The dog barks
complications.text: The small dog realises it is in a place with strangers and says so, at great length.
complications.absorbed_text: A strong word and a treat quiet the dog.
complications.flavor: It is, in fairness, a good bark.

complications.name: A sticky floor
complications.text: Someone spilled something sweet earlier and the floor has been quietly gluing itself to every shoe.
complications.absorbed_text: Someone with the right shoes steps around the stickiest bit.
complications.flavor: It tastes of blueberry.

complications.name: A long queue
complications.text: A queue forms in the one corridor the plan needs, about forty people deep and quite determined.
complications.absorbed_text: The queue is cheerfully redirected to a shorter line.
complications.flavor: Someone is selling snacks to it.

complications.name: The guard sneezes
complications.text: A guard around the corner sneezes enormously, then says 'who's there?' to nobody.
complications.absorbed_text: The guard sneezes and then forgets what he was going to say.
complications.flavor: Bless you.

complications.name: The lights flicker
complications.text: The lights flicker, die and come back on, and every camera reboots with a small, sleepy sigh.
complications.absorbed_text: A quick hand throws the right switch and the lights hardly dip.
complications.flavor: The fuse box is held together with tape.
